svg.text: Both resamples share ONE 2-tap kernel: out = (1-mu) in[k] + mu in[k+1].
Range: the source grid is UNIFORM in j, so k and mu are closed form -- no search.
Azimuth: the source (tan_s) is NON-uniform, so k comes from a monotone merge scan.
The 2-D FFT is SEPARABLE. That is the whole reason the
hardware can do two 1-D passes with a transpose between
them, instead of a 2-D transform it has no memory for.
Dashed = fused on hardware, no pass of its own. This is the CORRECTNESS reference: the fabric build is trusted
by matching these values sample by sample, not by matching the Python code structure.
